name: intel_mcs85
title: Intel MCS-85 (8085)
description: The Intel MCS-85 is the microprocessor family built around the Intel 8085, an 8-bit CISC CPU introduced in 1976. This platform targets the 8085 with an LLVM/Clang toolchain and supports baremetal development, with an OMEN ALPHA homebrew-computer board definition.

baremetal.description: Baremetal environment (no framework) for Intel 8085 microcontrollers
baremetal.title: Baremetal
